column2: Exact entry HEAD, TREE, branch, clean worktree and zero replace refs verified.
CENSUS01 five-commit terminal CLOSE/PASS established from real local Git commits.
Frozen predecessor paths/hashes established and their historical verdicts preserved.
All nine active PolyC compiler decision sites re-proved at production object/link/call level.
C0 baselines measured with exact parser/lexer/cross-target/policy identities.
Five real RED observations with actual measured outcomes, not scripted assertions.
Fifty AC IDs and twenty-four control IDs frozen before C2 and set-join without duplicates.
Two `*-tmp.HC` scope questions resolved as historical compliance classifications, not silently dropped.
Historical census bundle cost/adapter/vendored/pre-migrated units classified without rewriting CENSUS01.
CENSUS01 SCC/graph assumptions distinguished from genuinely mandatory migration dependencies.
Each of six named state families inventoried against live source and object provenance.
All retained source range facts include blob/phase/range SHA and real call/use evidence.
Allocation, owner, aliasing, borrow and lifetime properties recorded for each family.
Callback, state and recovery constraints independently enumerated, including unresolved edges.
PolyC dialect/FFI compatibility tested through real compiler and executable probes.
Handle token representation chosen from measured ABI results, not unsafe pointer/`I64` assumption.
Host never exposes direct C struct layout, field offsets or raw dereference to PolyC.
Host validates token kind, generation, lifetime and ownership domain where applicable.
Null, wrong-kind, stale and unissued handle results are specified and observable.
Borrow, invalidation, arena teardown and aliasing semantics explicitly specified.
Container mutation authorization and failure atomicity specified from real C semantics.
Callback reentrancy and recovery are status-bound or explicitly blocked; no cross-frame `longjmp`.
Selected AST-read probe uses genuine production C type/library code, not a mirror struct.
Selected container mutation probe uses genuine production C type/library code.
PolyC probe genuinely compiled by a digest-bound compiler producer.
Object/disassembly proves actual PolyC-to-C host symbol linkage and correct calling convention.
AST read result matches independent C-only oracle and is externally observable.
Container mutation result matches independent C-only oracle and is externally observable.
Host errors and invalid token scenarios are observed without process crash or UB-based detector.
PolyC-source causal mutation changes actual linked probe behavior and restores byte-identically.
Probe tool/verifier compiles and its genuine selftest rejects tampered inputs.
Real C host, PolyC object, link closure and runtime provenance fully recorded.
C2 handle/ownership contract versioned with precise signatures, target assumptions and negative operations.
Original mandatory-edge graph reconstructed from CENSUS01 raw IDs/hashes, not recopied summary.
Every proposed edge cut bound to an actual original edge and an ABI experiment or marked unproven.
Only source-representative executed cuts classified `CUT_PROVEN_BY_EXECUTION`.
Before/after graph partition computed mechanically; no invented cut or SCC shrinkage.
Distinct independent SCC implementation reproduces both partitions and edge sets.
Remaining uncut `CALLBACK`, `MUTABLE_STATE` and `RECOVERY` constraints preserved as blockers.
Forecast impact excludes out-of-scope, adapters and already-migrated work, with unresolved uncertainty.
Independent model recompute agrees with any scenario changes; historical 355 remains labeled a baseline.
All 24 controls executed with exact detector, input identity and pristine/adverse/restored evidence.
Negative-control exact-ID join has zero missing, extra, duplicate, vacuous or wrong-subject rows.
Parser baseline 376/376 and exact assertion sequence conserved; no new parser failures.
All three direct lexer differentials conserved; LEXER07 15-ID historical failure set unchanged.
Cross-target 67, F-NO-PYTHON 12 and unavailable F-POLYC-TOOLS reported honestly.
Production `src/**`, bootstrap tools, active selectors and all closed evidence byte-unchanged.
gate-fast, gate-push, F14, append-only, Factory-v2, closure-status and patch hygiene PASS.
Independent C3 ledger proves AC01..AC49; HANDOFF selects only an ACT class, not a new migration target.
One terminal CLOSE with external post-CLOSE read-only terminality PASS, clean tree, no continuation/worktree residue.
